WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), above_average AS (
  SELECT order_count,
         AVG(order_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM counts
  WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM counts)
)
SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(order_count - average_count) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;
